verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gotam naar ahiliaa tis no dhekh i(n)dhrr lobhaanaa|

en.bdb: Ahalya was the wife of Gautam. When Indar, the king of gods, set eyes on her, he was overcome with lust.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਪਛੋਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: par ghar jai saraap lai hoi sahas bhag pachhotaanaa|

en.bdb: He entered their house, got curse of being with thousands of pudendums and repented.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞਾ ਹੋਆ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੁ ਲੁਕਿਆ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: su(n)n(j)aa hoaa i(n)dhrr lok lukiaa saravar man saramaanaa|

en.bdb: The Indralok (abode of Indr) became desolate and getting ashamed of himself he hid in a pond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਭਗਹੁ ਲੋਇਣ ਸਹਸ ਲੈਂਦੋਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਿਧਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sahas bhagahu loin sahas lai(n)dhoiee i(n)dhr puree sidhaanaa|

en.bdb: On revocation of the curse when all those holes became eyes, only then he returned to his habitat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਸਤਹੁ ਟਲਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satee satahu Tal silaa hoi nadhee kinaarai baajh paraanaa|

en.bdb: Ahalya who could not remain steadfast in her chastity became stone and remained lying on the river bank

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਚਰਣਿ ਛੁਹੰਦਿਆ ਚਲੀ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਣੇ ਬਿਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: raghupat charan chhuha(n)dhiaa chalee surag pur bane bibaanaa|

en.bdb: Touching the (holy) feet of Ram, she was lifted to the heavens.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਲਿਆਈਅਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal bhaliaaieeahu patit udhaaran paap kamaanaa|

en.bdb: Because of His benevolence He is mother-like to the devotees and being forgiver of the sinners He is called redeemer of the fallen ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gun no gun sabh ko karai aaugun keete gun tis jaanaa|

en.bdb: Doing good is returned by good gestures always, but he who does good to the evil is known as virtuous.
How can I explain the greatness of that unmanifest (Lord).
